title.narrative: of industrial and rural associative MSMEs supported that have incorporated innovation, circular practices, technology and have been supported with acceleration actions, led or presided by women.

description.narrative: At least 200 MSMEs supported (2023) and 30% womenled (2023)Note (1): Refers to MSMEs supported with funds allocated to UNIDO through the Contribution Agreement. Support to these MSMEs is provided through the innovation mechanism, the circular opportunities program, the purchase of smallscale agricultural machinery for value addition, and scalable pilots carried out with successful MSMEs. Of the total number of MSMEs supported, a percentage must be led by women or presided over by women or have women in management positions.Note (3): This goal is to be achieved in collaboration with FECOPROD and UIP.

comment.narrative: See UNIDO progress Report for period june 2021 to june 2022. 26 MSMEs incorporating innovation 96 of which are womenled 13 MSMEs to incorporate circular practices 53 of which are women led
